wikitext: [[File:A Sylveon Bedtime Story.png|thumb|350px|A Sylveon Bedtime Story]] '''A Sylveon Bedtime Story''' (Japanese: '''おねむりストーリー ニンフィア''' ''A {{tt|Nymphia|Sylveon}} Sleeping Story'') is a 1-minute {{pkmn|animation|animated}} short based on [[Pokémon Sleep]]. It was released on the official Pokémon [[YouTube]] channels and {{pkmn|social media}} accounts on November 14, 2024, as a promotion for the Eevee Week event and accompanied by an in-game event making it easier to encounter [[Eeveelution]]s and also a distribution of a {{p|Sylveon}} {{Sleep|Incense}}. ==Blurb== Ready to wind down for bed? How about a few calming cuddles from Sylveon first? 🎀💖 ==Plot== In a forest clearing, {{Sleep|Snorlax}}, {{p|Clefairy}}, {{p|Mimikyu}}, and {{p|Pikachu}} are eating from a tower of {{b|Pecha}}, {{b|Sitrus}}, and {{b|Bluk}} {{Berries}}, while {{p|Eevee}} is running circles around {{p|Sylveon}}. Eevee notices the Berry tower and runs toward it. Eevee tries to pull a berry out from the bottom of the tower, but it imbalances the tower and makes all the berries fall down on top of Eevee. Sylveon, worried, runs toward the pile and starts digging through it with its ribbons. It removes Clefairy, Pikachu, and Mimikyu, but sets them aside. Using its ribbons, it picks up all the berries and sets them aside, with Eevee being thrown up into the air as a result. Sylveon jumps and catches Eevee with its ribbons. Eevee presents Sylveon with a [[Persim Berry]], which Sylveon accepts, and they nuzzle their cheeks together. Later, all of the Pokémon are asleep around Snorlax, with Eevee on Snorlax's belly, as a {{p|Cubone}} looks at them from behind a bush. Eevee falls down from Snorlax's belly, rolls away and bumps into Sylveon, who also rolls and gets entangled in its ribbons. The scene changes to Sylveon's "[[Sleep style|Ribbon-Tangled Sleep]]" style being recorded in the Sleep Style Dex. ==Characters== ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Snorlax}} ([[Snorlax (Sleep)|Sleep]]) * {{p|Eevee}} * {{p|Sylveon}} * {{p|Clefairy}} * {{p|Mimikyu}} * {{p|Pikachu}} * {{p|Cubone}} ==Cast== {{cast/h|Kanto}} {{cast|Sinnoh|Snorlax (Pokémon)|disp=Snorlax|Katsuyuki Konishi|Kabigon|Katsuyuki Konishi|カビゴン|小西克幸|top=yes}} {{cast|Sinnoh|Clefairy (Pokémon)|disp=Clefairy|Mayumi Iizuka|Pippi|Mayumi Iizuka|ピッピ|飯塚雅弓}} {{cast|Sinnoh|Mimikyu (Pokémon)|disp=Mimikyu|Daisuke Namikawa|Mimikkyu|Daisuke Namikawa|ミミッキュ|浪川大輔}} {{cast|Sinnoh|Pikachu (Pokémon)|disp=Pikachu|Ikue Otani|Pikachu|Ikue Otani|ピカチュウ|大谷育江}} {{cast|Sinnoh|Sylveon (Pokémon)|disp=Sylveon|Mika Kanai|Nymphia|Mika Kanai|ニンフィア|かないみか}} {{cast|Sinnoh|Eevee (Pokémon)|disp=Eevee|Aoi Yuki|Eievui|Aoi Yuki|イーブイ|悠木碧|bottom=yes}} |} ==Staff== {| class="credits-table roundtable" style="background: #{{Fairy color light}}; border: 3px solid #{{Normal color}}" |- style="vertical-align: middle; background:#fff" ! class="roundytl" width="24%" | Director / Script / Storyboards | class="roundytr" width="38%" | * Yoshimitsu Saito |- style="vertical-align: middle; background:#fff" !
